parameters.query:
WITH ready AS (
  SELECT id FROM content.items
  WHERE org_id = $1
    AND status = 'enriched'
    AND (enrich_result->>'keep')::boolean = true
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 5 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE content.items i SET status = 'batch_rewriting', locked_at = now(), updated_at = now()
FROM ready WHERE i.id = ready.id
RETURNING i.id, i.title, i.body, i.raw_payload->>'topic' AS topic;

nodes.name: Pick up to 5 items
nodes.notes: State: enriched → batch_rewriting (transitional, safe to co-run with workflow 06 via SKIP LOCKED, but prefer ONE of 06/08 per org to avoid double-spend on LLM).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO content.drafts (item_id, org_id, platform, variant_key, body, hashtags, status, scheduled_at, queued_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, $8, now())
ON CONFLICT (item_id, platform, variant_key) DO UPDATE
  SET updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, item_id, queued_at;

nodes.name: Save drafts
nodes.notes:
WF08 does NOT push to Google Sheet review queue (editors access batch-v1 drafts via admin UI). Therefore queued_at = now() is set here at INSERT time so the WF06/WF08 shared gate semantics stay consistent: 'queued_at IS NOT NULL' = editor-visible.

X1 (round X): changed ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING → DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now() RETURNING id,item_id,queued_at. Rationale: same class bug fixed for WF06 in W1. If a previous run already inserted all batch-v1 drafts but failed before Mark items drafted, a pure DO NOTHING would conflict on every row and emit zero items → Mark items drafted never triggers → items stay stuck in 'batch_rewriting'. DO UPDATE (no-op, updated_at only) GUARANTEES output on every conflict so the downstream mark query always runs. We intentionally do NOT overwrite body/hashtags/status because editors may have touched them in admin UI between retries.

parameters.query:
UPDATE content.items i
SET status = 'drafted', locked_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE i.id = ANY(string_to_array($1, ',')::uuid[])
  AND i.status = 'batch_rewriting'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM content.drafts d
    WHERE d.item_id = i.id
      AND d.variant_key = 'batch-v1'
      AND d.queued_at IS NOT NULL
  )
RETURNING i.id;

nodes.name: Mark items drafted
nodes.notes:
W2 (round W): previously this UPDATE-ed every claimed id unconditionally — when the LLM returned fewer results than the batch, items without a draft were marked 'drafted' anyway. Now we require (a) status still = 'batch_rewriting' (idempotent against retry/requeue) AND (b) an EXISTS row in content.drafts with variant_key='batch-v1' AND queued_at IS NOT NULL (editor-visible). Items missing a draft stay 'batch_rewriting' with locked_at ≠ NULL → WF07 branch B alerts on-call after 30 minutes.

X1 (round X): this node still reads ids from $('Pack batch').first(), so it does not depend on Save drafts output cardinality. BUT it only fires if Save drafts emits at least one item (n8n pipeline semantics). Save drafts now uses DO UPDATE RETURNING so emission is guaranteed on full-conflict retry.
